title: 第93章 唐逸闭关，练绝世神功！

s宁川和萧棣都震惊地看着唐逸，你来真的？那特妈可是暗京楼，陛下恨得牙痒痒的暗京楼。数百顶级杀手，你一个不会武功的家伙，说将他们全部留下，就能将他们全部留下？开什么玩笑？而唐逸也没和他们解释，在他们还在震惊的时候，已经转身离开了。本来还想趁着上班的时间，去资料室多查一点暗京楼的资料的，但现在这些都不重要了。你有张良计，老子有过墙梯。你们有武功？没关系，老子懂科技。武功再高，也怕杀猪刀，更何况要伺候你们的，是炸弹炸药包！想玩？那就玩大点，直接梭哈的那种！“宁头，他……他说什么？”萧棣回过神，手缓缓将自己的下巴合上。宁川看着空荡荡的大门，咬牙道：“他说……我特妈疯了！”说完，宁川丢下萧棣，当即急匆匆进宫了。“嗯，是真够特妈疯的，不过，老子喜欢。”萧棣摸着下巴，忽然感觉唐逸这家伙还是不错的，至少……敢于做梦。“唐逸，等等老子，老子帮你啊！”萧棣直接追了出去，他很想知道唐逸要造的大杀器，到底是什么。唐逸出了北镇抚司，萧棣便已经追上他了。对于萧棣的要求，唐逸没有拒绝，直接带着他就去了市场，炸药已经配置得差不多了，不够回去再配置一点就行，现在他需要的是材料。譬如易燃物，导火索，容器等等。而在他在市场逛的时候，宁川马不停蹄的进了皇宫，见到了炎文帝。御书房，炎文帝听完宁川的回报后，也是惊得站了起来，目瞪口呆：“这小子……这小子真是这么说的？他要制造一个大杀器，灭了暗京楼这几百精锐？”宁川拱手道：“是，唐逸就是这么说的，而且说得信誓旦旦，已经在准备了。”听到这话，炎文帝直接冲着陈貂寺道：“备车，去唐家，朕要看那小子要做什么。”“朕以身为饵做局，就是要将暗京楼这群老鼠全揪出来杀了，他可别坏了朕的大事。”“还造一个大杀器杀全场？谁给他的底气的？”宁川抬头看了一眼炎文帝，眼神有些幽怨，他的底气可不就是陛下你给的吗？陈貂寺刚转身，炎文帝又开口道：“罢了，让他们闹吧，年轻人，有想法是好事，玩砸了，朕给他们擦屁股就好了。”这时候可不能出去！万一出去暗京楼那群老鼠闻着味过来咋办？现在还不是摊牌的时候。宁川听到这话都快哭了，陛下，你看，你又开始纵容。炎文帝坐回龙椅，沉吟了一下道：“宁川，不用管唐逸和萧棣，这几日尽快将沈园诗会的保卫工作做好。”“这次参加沈园诗会的，都是京都名门望族，无论如何，都要保证他们的安全。”宁川拱手道：“臣遵旨。”“嗯，退下吧。”炎文帝挥了挥手，让宁川退下。他指尖轻轻敲着桌案，沉默许久看向陈貂寺道：“去，加派人手保护唐逸，同时，这几日给朕盯紧他和萧棣，朕要知道，他们两个到底想要干什么！”“还有，传出消息，唐逸正在闭关修炼绝世神功，两日后灭暗京楼。”陈貂寺打了一个眼色，一个伺候的小太监，便急匆匆出了大殿。“唐逸，你买这些东西干嘛？”“我草，这是水银？这东西有毒，你想干嘛？毒死那群宵小？”“木头？火线？铁？瓷器？铁钉……我擦，你怎么连夜壶都拿？你到底想要干什么？”“……”逛了半个京城，萧棣看着被塞得满满当当的四五车乱七八糟的东西，整个人有些无语问苍天。关键是，唐逸还不给他解释。这让萧棣气得要打人，花他的钱，用他的人，驾他的车，还不鸟他，能压下火都是他萧棣好脾气了。直到下午，十辆马车全满了，唐逸才心满意足，拍了拍手看向萧棣：“能找个安全安静的地方吗？我要开始制作炸弹了。”“炸蛋？！”萧棣下意识夹紧腿，和唐逸拉开距离。他可是记得清楚，这家伙喜欢掏裆。昨日林豹被他掏了一下，今天走路的姿势还很别扭。“此炸弹非彼炸蛋，你想什么呢你？”唐逸瞪了萧棣一眼，道：“我需要一个安静的地方，制作灭暗京楼的秘密武器，到底有没有，给个痛快话！”唐逸自然是不会将这些东西带回唐家的！一是制作炸弹有一定的风险，万一发生意外可能会伤害到妹妹和杜凌菲。二是……唐家有颜霜玉和唐画兄弟在，肯定会发生意外。萧棣沉吟了一下，道：“那就去我的王府吧！反正我的王府也是空着，除了我就那么几个人。”“行，那就去王府。”唐逸愉快决定。王府，闲杂人等不敢轻易进，安全性高。就是有他捣鼓炸弹，内部不怎么安全就是了。萧棣看着唐逸的笑脸，莫名一阵心虚，总感觉要发生点什么事情。只是看了一眼花了他几百两，买下来的十几车瓶瓶罐罐，他又有些好奇，唐逸拿这些东西，到底要怎么造出神秘武器的。想到这些萧棣咬牙一挥手，十辆马车便浩浩荡荡回燕王府。将所有东西都卸下，搬到北院之后，唐逸便让萧棣派心腹回了一趟唐家，找杜凌菲拿他昨晚配好的颗粒火药。同时，唐逸让萧棣亲自坐镇北园，他没有出来之前，萧棣不得离开半步。见到唐逸郑重认真的样子，萧棣心头更加心虚了，我是我心怀歹意，只是我怎么总感觉这家伙没安好心啊！他想要拉着我一起死。吐槽归吐槽，萧棣还是痛快答应唐逸，亲自坐镇外面。唐逸便回了房间，开始搞炸弹。……北城，一栋四合院中。月黑风高夜，龙斩一手拿着手帕不断咳嗽，一只手却提着水壶，正在给院中的菊花浇水。“舵主，宫里传来消息，说唐逸正在修炼一门神功，能将我们暗京楼一网打尽。”身后，孙霸抱着刀，满脸杀意：“要不，你还是让我亲自出手，宰了这家伙吧！”龙斩闻言眼睛眯了起来，道：“唐逸，在练一门绝世神功，能将我们一网打尽？”“他，一个人？！”孙霸点点头，道：“对，炎文帝身边的人，传出来的消息就是这么说的。”“如今，他正在燕王府闭关呢！”龙斩回头看向孙霸，道：“唐逸会武功？”孙霸满脸不屑，道：“怎么可能，我已经将他唐逸查得底朝天了，他就是个爹不疼娘早死的废物，不会一点武功。”“咳咳……”龙斩咳了两声，擦了擦嘴角的血迹，道：“那你觉得两天的时间，能让一个没有武功的人，练成绝世武功？”孙霸嗤笑道：“那不可能，就是他悟性通天彻地，想要在两天练成绝世高手，根本就不可能！”“我练刀练了二十年，如今武功也不过二流……但要杀他唐逸，一刀足够。”龙斩放下水壶，眯着眼睛看向皇宫方向。皇帝，你到底玩的什么把戏？不过没关系，随便你玩什么把戏，你的命，我暗京楼收定了。“去准备一下，后天的沈园诗会，我也参加！”
content_en: s Ning Chuan and Xiao Di both looked at Tang Yi in shock, are you serious?That mother is the Anjing Tower, the Anjing Tower that Your Majesty hates so much.There are hundreds of top killers. You, a guy who doesn't know martial arts, can you keep them all if you say you can keep them all?Are you kidding me?And Tang Yi didn't explain to them. While they were still shocked, he turned around and left.I originally wanted to take advantage of my working time to go to the data room to check more information about Anjing Tower, but now these are not important.You have a good plan, I have a ladder.Do you have martial arts skills?It doesn't matter, I understand technology.No matter how high your martial arts skills are, you are still afraid of the butcher's knife, let alone what you have to serve are bombs and explosives!Want to play?Then play a bigger game, the direct stud type!"Ning Tou, he... what did he say?" Xiao Di came back to his senses and slowly closed his chin with his hand.Ning Chuan looked at the empty door and gritted his teeth: "He said... I'm crazy!" After saying that, Ning Chuan left Xiao Di and hurried into the palace."Well, it's really crazy, but I like it." Xiao Di touched his chin and suddenly felt that Tang Yi was pretty good, at least... he dared to dream."Tang Yi, wait a minute, I'll help you!" Xiao Di chased after him directly. He wanted to know what the killer weapon Tang Yi wanted to build was.When Tang Yi left Beizhen Fusi, Xiao Di had already caught up with him.Tang Yi did not refuse Xiao Di's request and took him directly to the market. The explosives were almost ready. If it was not enough, he could go back and prepare more. What he needed now were materials.For example, flammable materials, fuses, containers, etc.While he was walking around the market, Ning Chuan entered the palace without stopping and met Emperor Yanwen.In the imperial study room, after hearing Ning Chuan's report, Emperor Yan Wen stood up in shock and was dumbfounded: "This boy... did this boy really say that? He wants to create a big killer weapon and destroy the hundreds of elites in Anjing Tower?" Ning Chuan said with a cupped hand: "Yes, that's what Tang Yi said, and he said it categorically, and he is already preparing." After hearing this, Emperor Yan Wen directly faced ChenDiao Si said: "Prepare the car and go to the Tang family. I want to see what that boy is going to do." "I am using myself as a bait to catch all the rats in Anjing Tower and kill them. He must not ruin my big deal." "And build a big killer to kill everyone? Who gave him the confidence?" Ning Chuan looked up at Emperor Yanwen, his eyes a little resentful. Wasn't his confidence given by your majesty?Just as Chen Diaosi turned around, Emperor Yanwen said again: "Forget it, let them make trouble. Young people, it's a good thing to have ideas. If they mess up, I can just wipe their butts." You can't go out at this time!What if the rats from Anjing Tower smell the smell and come over?Now is not the time for a showdown.Ning Chuan almost cried when he heard this. Your Majesty, look, you are conniving again.Emperor Yan Wen sat back on the dragon chair, pondered for a while and said: "Ningchuan, don't worry about Tang Yi and Xiao Di. We will do a good job in protecting the Shen Yuan Poetry Society as soon as possible in the next few days." "The people participating in the Shen Yuan Poetry Society this time are all famous families in Kyoto. No matter what, their safety must be ensured." Ning Chuan cupped his hands and said, "I obey." "Well, stand down." Emperor Yan Wen waved his hand and asked Ning Chuan to stand down.He tapped the table with his fingertips, and looked at Chen Diao Si in silence for a long time: "Go, send more people to protect Tang Yi, and at the same time, keep an eye on him and Xiao Di these days. I want to know what the two of them want to do!" "Also, there is news that Tang Yi is practicing peerless magic in seclusion, and will destroy the Anjing Tower in two days." Chen Diao Si winked, and a serving eunuch hurried out of the hall."Tang Yi, why did you buy these things?" "Holy shit, this is mercury? This thing is poisonous. What do you want to do? Poison those little boys?" "Wood? Live wire? Iron? Porcelain? Iron nails... I wonder, why did you even take the chamber pot? What on earth do you want to do?" "..." After wandering half of the capital, Xiao Di looked at the four or five cars full of messy things, and he was speechless and asked the sky.The key is that Tang Yi hasn't given him an explanation yet.This made Xiao Di so angry that he wanted to hit someone. He spent his money, used his people, and drove his car without being disrespectful to him. It was only because of his good temper that he could suppress his anger.It wasn't until the afternoon that all ten carriages were full. Tang Yi was satisfied. He clapped his hands and looked at Xiao Di: "Can you find a safe and quiet place? I'm going to start making bombs." "Exploded eggs?!" Xiao Di subconsciously clamped his legs and distanced himself from Tang Yi.He remembered clearly that this guy liked to pick his crotch.Lin Bao was touched by him yesterday, and his walking posture today is still very awkward."This bomb is not the other's fried egg. What are you thinking?" Tang Yi glared at Xiao Di and said, "I need a quiet place to make the secret weapon to destroy Anjing Tower. Tell me if I have it!" Of course Tang Yi would not bring these things back to the Tang family!First, there are certain risks in making bombs. If an accident occurs, my sister and Du Lingfei may be harmed.The second is... With brothers Yan Shuangyu and Tang Hua in the Tang family, accidents will definitely happen.Xiao Di pondered for a moment and said: "Then go to my palace! Anyway, my palace is empty, and there are only a few people except me." "Okay, then go to the palace." Tang Yi decided happily.No one can easily enter the palace, so security is high.Even though he was tinkering with bombs, it wasn't very safe inside.Xiao Di looked at Tang Yi's smiling face and felt guilty inexplicably, always feeling that something was going to happen.Just taking a look at the dozens of bottles and cans that cost him hundreds of taels, he was a little curious about how Tang Yi used these things to create a mysterious weapon.Thinking of these, Xiao Di gritted his teeth and waved his hand, and ten carriages drove back to Prince Yan's Mansion.After unloading everything and moving it to the North Courtyard, Tang Yi asked Xiao Di to send his confidants back to the Tang family to find Du Lingfei to get the gunpowder particles he prepared last night.At the same time, Tang Yi asked Xiao Di to take charge of Beiyuan personally. Xiao Di was not allowed to leave even half a step before he came out.Seeing Tang Yi's solemn and serious look, Xiao Di felt even more guilty. I mean I have malicious intentions, but why do I always feel that this guy has no good intentions?He wanted to drag me to death with him.Complaints remain complaints, but Xiao Di happily agreed to Tang Yi and sit outside personally.Tang Yi went back to the room and started making bombs....Beicheng, in a courtyard house.On a dark and windy night, Long Zhan held a handkerchief in one hand and kept coughing, while the other hand held a kettle and was watering the chrysanthemums in the courtyard."Master, there is news from the palace that Tang Yi is repairing
